name: Waseda University
description: Waseda University is a private university in Shinjuku, Tokyo, founded in 1882 by Okuma Shigenobu. It has 13 undergraduate schools and the largest international student body of any Japanese university.
whyIncluded: Waseda has run a Singapore office since 2004, the Public Service Commission places scholars at Waseda and visited it in 2025 to expand opportunities for scholarship holders, and Japan is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: Waseda publishes only a rough total, so this uses the national survey average for international students in Tokyo: housing, food, transport and personal costs, 12 months a year.
livingCosts.notes: Waseda publishes only a total (about ¥1,000,000-¥2,000,000 a year for accommodation and living expenses, SILS applicants page), not a breakdown. Figures are JASSO 2023 Lifestyle Survey of Privately-Financed International Students (令和5年度私費外国人留学生生活実態調査, table 7-4), Tokyo average monthly spending in ¥1,000s: housing 57 + utilities 7, food 37, commuting 6, personal = hobbies/leisure 10 + other daily costs 10. Excludes study/research costs (56, includes tuition) and insurance/medical (3).

programmes.name: Waseda Law School (Juris Doctor, 法曹養成専攻)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for the 3-year Japanese bar law degree (2 with a law degree). The ¥300,000 admission fee is spread into this yearly figure, so there is no separate entrance fee. The one-off ¥5,000 is a student association joining fee.
programmes.notes: 法曹養成専攻 (Graduate School of Law, Legal Practice major) row of the 2026 master's and professional degree fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,143,000 = ¥1,443,000, the same as tuition in years 2 and 3, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the other Waseda entries). Other fees per year = practical-training/seminar fee ¥120,000 + student association annual fee ¥2,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥125,000; the ¥5,000 student association entry fee is paid once. Standard duration 3 years (2 years for students entering with a law degree). Japanese-taught professional degree preparing for the Japanese bar; the former Law School (法務研究科) was reorganised into the Graduate School of Law from April 2025. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants (法務研究科 row): ¥300,000 + ¥1,160,000 = ¥1,460,000 in year 1 and ¥1,360,000 in years 2-3 (not levelled), seminar fee ¥100,000; first-year figures recorded. Replaces an earlier entry taken from a preparatory-school summary, whose figures matched the 2024 table.

Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,081,000 = ¥1,281,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the engineering entry). Other fees per year (spring + autumn semester) = practical-training fee ¥1,950 x 2 + reading-room library fee ¥250 x 2 + academic society annual fee ¥750 x 2 + health mutual-aid ¥1,500 x 2 = ¥8,900; the ¥2,000 academic society entry fee is paid once. programmes.name: Graduate School of Fundamental Science and Engineering (Master's, Computer Science and Communications Engineering)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for the 2-year master's, the same each year. The ¥300,000 admission fee is spread into this yearly figure, so there is no separate entrance fee. Lab and health fees are extra.
programmes.notes: 基幹理工学研究科 情報理工・情報通信専攻 row (shared with mechanical science and aerospace, electronic and physical systems, intermedia studies) of the 2026 master's fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥991,000 = ¥1,291,000, the same as tuition in year 2, so the admission fee is included in tuition. Other fees per year = seminar/lab fee ¥96,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥99,000. English-based International Graduate Program available. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥962,000 = ¥1,262,000 (year 2 ¥1,162,000, not levelled); the 2024 table gives the lab fee only as a school-wide range ¥70,000-96,000, so the 2024 history entry carries only tuition. 2024 row completed from the Faculty of Science and Engineering's own '＜2024年度入学者向け＞入学金・学費・諸会費 6-1.修士課程' PDF (https://www.waseda.jp/fsci/assets/uploads/2024/04/20240325_jp_01_TuitionFees_2024NewStudents.pdf, published 12 Apr 2024, linked from waseda.jp/fsci/admissions_gs/tuition/ in the Wayback capture 20240705173838 as '2024年度入学者向け入学金・学費・諸会費 (2024.4.12更新)'). The PDF gives per-department fees per term (第1期/第2期). Direct download returns 403, so it was read on 2026-10-05 through the r.jina.ai reader. Per-department 実験演習料 (lab/seminar fee) per term plus 学生健康増進互助会費 ¥1,500 per term. The column headers do not survive text extraction, but the first-year columns are identical in the faculty's 2025-entrant PDF (20241028_jp_01_TuitionFees_2025NewStudents.pdf), except the business-design (経営D) columns (¥60,000 in 2024, ¥47,000 in 2025). So the department's 2024 first-year lab fee equals its 2025 figure already on file. 基幹研 table: 授業料 ¥481,000 per term (admission ¥300,000 + 2 x ¥481,000 = ¥1,262,000, unchanged); 情報・通信 lab fee ¥48,000 per term in both year-1 terms (the ¥48,000 group shared with 機航/電子/表現/建築, as in 2025) = ¥96,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥99,000. This matches the ¥70,000-96,000 school range in the university-wide 2024 table.

programmes.name: School of Humanities and Social Sciences (Psychology course)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition, the same each year. The ¥200,000 admission fee is spread into this yearly figure, so there is no separate entrance fee. Course-specific lab fees may be added from year 2. Taught in Japanese.
programmes.notes: Psychology course (心理学コース) of the School of Humanities and Social Sciences (文学部), chosen from year 2 (https://www.waseda.jp/flas/hss/). 文学部 row of the 2026 undergraduate fee table: spring (entry) admission fee ¥200,000 + tuition ¥545,500 + reading-room library fee ¥500 + health mutual-aid ¥1,500 = ¥747,500; autumn tuition ¥545,500 + ¥500 + ¥1,500 = ¥547,500; first-year total ¥1,295,000. Admission fee + first-year tuition = ¥1,291,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the other Waseda entries). Compulsory fees per year = library ¥1,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥4,000; no first-year lab fee, but note 2 of the table says lab/practical fees may be charged from year 2 depending on the course. Japanese-taught 4-year degree. 2025 table: identical 文学部 amounts (¥1,295,000 first year, tuition ¥1,291,000). 2024 table: admission ¥200,000 + tuition ¥1,091,000 + library ¥1,000 + other fees ¥3,000 = ¥1,295,000; tuition years 2-4 ¥1,291,000.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Letters, Arts and Sciences (Master's, Psychology course)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for the 2-year master's, the same each year. The ¥300,000 admission fee is spread into this yearly figure. Compulsory fees include a ¥30,000 seminar fee. Taught in Japanese.
programmes.notes: 文学研究科 心理学コース row of the 2026 master's and professional degree fee table: admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥622,000 = ¥922,000, the same as tuition in year 2, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the other Waseda entries). Compulsory fees per year = seminar fee (演習料) ¥30,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥33,000; first-year total ¥955,000. Japanese-taught. 2025 table shows the same 心理学コース amounts. 2024 table gives one 文学研究科 row: admission ¥300,000 + tuition ¥624,000 = ¥924,000 in year 1 and tuition ¥824,000 in year 2 (not levelled); the first-year figure is recorded. Its seminar fee is shown only as a range (¥0-60,000) without a per-course figure, so the 2024 row carries tuition only. Waseda's other psychology master's, the clinical psychology field of the Graduate School of Human Sciences, costs ¥1,210,000 a year plus ¥93,000 in fees. 2024 row left tuition-only. The fee table found for 2024 is the university-wide 2024 master's table, which gives the 文学研究科 seminar fee only as a range (¥0-60,000) with no per-course figure. The Faculty of Science and Engineering's per-department 2024 PDF (used for the three engineering entries) does not cover the Graduate School of Letters, Arts and Sciences. No 文学学術院 per-course 2024 fee page or PDF was located within the time box, and the 2025 心理学コース ¥30,000 seminar fee cannot be assumed for 2024.
